indicator_label: Genuinely uncertain — open sale process, no buyer named yet
summary: Noble is running two tracks at once — a going-concern sale auction and an orderly liquidation — and hasn't committed to either outcome. The single biggest open question is whether a stalking-horse or winning bidder emerges by the Oct 30 bid deadline.
positive_signals: Bidding Procedures Order was entered 8 days ahead of its own court-ordered deadline — the case is moving faster than required, not slower.
Broad marketing process: Portage Point had contacted ~105 prospective buyers and ~25 had signed NDAs as of the Sept 7 filing, before the process was even court-approved.
Secured lenders continue to consent to cash-collateral use under a rolling budget rather than forcing an immediate liquidation.
Noble won a discrete early fight with the Defense Logistics Agency: the court ordered DLA to release $6.43M of frozen invoice payments on Sept 18, 2026.

On paper, consolidated assets ($1.32B reported for the lead entity in the stub-period MOR) substantially exceed total funded debt (~$292M) — though a forced or distressed sale rarely recovers full book value, especially for government-contract-dependent inventory and receivables.
risk_signals: No stalking-horse bidder has been designated as of this update. Noble entered Chapter 11 without one, which is a materially riskier starting position than a pre-negotiated sale.

The relationship with DLA — Noble's largest customer — remains damaged: ~$400M of orders were terminated Aug 27, 2026 and an ~$86M contract dispute claim is still unresolved (separate from the smaller invoice-freeze fight Noble already won).
The sale timeline is compressed: bid deadline Oct 30, auction (if needed) Nov 4, sale hearing Nov 16, deadline to close Nov 20 — about 8 weeks total, leaving little room for delay.
WARN Act layoff notices were issued to all employees before the filing (Aug 10, 2026), reflecting workforce reductions already underway.
Monthly Operating Reports filed so far cover only a 2-day stub period, with 9 of 11 debtor entities reporting all-zero placeholder figures — too early to read an operating trend from MOR data yet.

watch_next.event: Deadline to designate a stalking-horse bidder (if any) — the single most important date to watch
Auction (if more than one qualified bid)
Deadline to close an approved sale
